subject: Career
title: The XYZ Formula
description: A micro-lesson that makes The XYZ Formula usable.

hook.text: Google's recruiters teach a formula: 'Accomplished X, as measured by Y, by doing Z.'

buildup.text: It forces you to include three things: the result, the evidence, and the method.

discovery.text: 'Reduced churn 18% (Y) by redesigning the onboarding flow (Z)' — clear, credible, specific.

twist.text: Most bullets fail because they only have Z — what you did — without X or Y.

climax.text: When you can't find Y, ask: what would have happened if I hadn't done this?

punchline.text: What you did matters less than what changed.

quiz.question: What does Google's XYZ resume formula stand for?
options: Accomplished X, measured by Y, by doing Z

details.summary: The XYZ formula structures resume bullets as 'Accomplished X as measured by Y by doing Z,' creating impact statements that clearly communicate what you achieved, how it was measured, and the method you used. Google's hiring teams recommend this exact structure.
details.whyItMatters: Unstructured bullet points bury your impact in noise. The XYZ formula forces clarity and ensures every bullet communicates measurable value rather than generic responsibilities.
takeaways: Structure: Accomplished X, measured by Y, by doing Z
Start each bullet with a strong action verb describing the accomplishment
Include the metric or measurement that proves the impact was real

faq.question: Can you provide an example of the XYZ resume formula in practice?
faq.answer: Instead of 'Managed social media accounts,' write 'Grew organic social media following by forty percent in six months by implementing a data-driven content strategy.' The accomplishment is growth, the measure is forty percent in six months, and the method is the content strategy.

faq.question: What if not every accomplishment fits cleanly into the XYZ formula?
faq.answer: Use XYZ for your strongest three to four bullets per role and adapt for others. Even partial application improves resume impact. An accomplishment with a clear result but no specific method is still stronger than a generic responsibility statement. Aim for XYZ when possible.
